items.computation: The invoice is a private commercial document, so the general period rules of §§ 187, 188 BGB apply (no statutory delivery-fiction for authority letters here). The triggering event is the invoice date, 2025-09-08 (Monday). Under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event itself is not counted; counting starts the next day, 2025-09-09. A 7-day period starting 2025-09-09 runs: 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 — so day 7 (the last day of the period, § 188(1) BGB) is 2025-09-15 (Monday). This date is not a Saturday, Sunday, or a Nordrhein-Westfalen public holiday, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
